description: Added `aspire secret` commands (`set`, `get`, `list`, `delete`, `path`) with `--environment`/`-e` support, so deployment workflows can configure secrets per environment ahead of time instead of relying on Development-only user secrets or prompts. Secrets now live in Aspire-owned files under `~/.aspire/secrets/<apphost-id>/<environment>.json`, with existing Development .NET user secrets imported automatically.
name: Environment-specific Aspire secrets for deployment
